entities.name: Philip Barton Key
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Philip Barton Key, was an American Loyalist during the American Revolutionary War and later was a United States Circuit Judge and Chief United States Circuit Judge of the United States circuit court for the Fourth Circuit and a United States representative from Maryland.
